recipe: Always call Hooks at the top level of your React function, before any early returns, so that the number and order of Hook calls remains consistent across renders.
trigger_condition: You are writing a function component or custom Hook and need to decide where to place your Hook calls.
evidence: Instead, always use Hooks at the top level of your React function, before any early returns.

recipe: Place all Hook calls before any conditional return statement so that every code path executes the same number of Hooks.
trigger_condition: Your component has early returns (e.g., guard clauses) and you need to use Hooks.
evidence: Do not call Hooks after a conditional `return` statement.

recipe: Do not call Hooks inside event handler functions; instead, call the Hook at the top level and reference its value inside the handler.
trigger_condition: You are writing an event handler and need a value that would normally come from a Hook.
evidence: Do not call Hooks in event handlers.

recipe: Do not call Hooks inside class components; convert the class component to a function component if you need Hooks.
trigger_condition: You are working with or refactoring a class component and want to use React Hooks.
evidence: Do not call Hooks in class components.

recipe: Do not call Hooks inside the callback functions passed to useMemo, useReducer, or useEffect; call them at the top level and pass the result as an argument.
trigger_condition: You are writing the callback for useMemo, useReducer, or useEffect and need a Hook value inside it.
evidence: Do not call Hooks inside functions passed to `useMemo`, `useReducer`, or `useEffect`.

recipe: Add the eslint-plugin-react-hooks to your project's ESLint configuration to automatically detect violations of the Rules of Hooks during development.
trigger_condition: You want automated, tooling-based detection of Hook placement mistakes in your codebase.
evidence: You can use the [`eslint-plugin-react-hooks` plugin](https://www.npmjs.com/package/eslint-plugin-react-hooks) to catch these mistakes.
